gaps.quote: A forward, inverse, forward schedule of these invocations exchanges the two banks
gaps.note: An inverse invocation is not defined. Two forward invocations X to Y with an inverse X to Y would just cancel, so inverse must mean the reverse direction, and with plain additions the three steps give a signed swap, not the exchange of the three updates D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D. The page does not say how this schedule relates to those three updates or to the recursion.
